latest_release.name: v0.52.667
latest_release.body:
## Known issues
- **Context meter after a reload or model switch (#8975).** For some sessions on custom or self-hosted endpoints, the
  context meter can show the default window (256K) instead of the model's real window after a page reload or a model
  switch. It corrects itself on the next turn. Compression and chats are unaffected. Context-management plugins that
  read WebUI's context window see the same default until then.
- Credentials can pair with the wrong URL on Agent builds after hermes-agent #151775 when a providers: entry named like a built-in provider has its own URL and model.base_url differs (#8973, Form 3). Present in every release; fix in progress.


## What's Changed
* release: #8903 `TestConflictError` no longer fails in focused or partial test runs (#8903) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8998
* test: TestConflictError starts with no registered chat runs (order-dependent failure in focused runs) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8903


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/compare/exp-v0.52.666...v0.52.667
